text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I've no clue why, but my head's been killing me lately.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Is it because I've been cramming slang words too hard?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I always end up overthinking how to use new words when I learn them. Using all that big brain energy's prolly causing my headache.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I wonder if it'll get better if I stop using slang and start talking more like a mature adult instead. Maybe I can try copying Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Actually, never mind… Maruzen's way of speaking is really out there too sometimes…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I mean, what does "this is the pits" even mean? Agh… My head!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer continues to suffer from her headache for some time.
